notes: FASTER FIRST LOAD: the loading screen is much shorter (about 6 s down to under 2 s on our test machine). The sky reflections now build just after the menu appears, and your gun's shaders get ready when the first match starts, not on the loading screen.

COLOUR-BLIND MODE (Settings > GAMEPLAY): DEUTERANOPIA (blue / amber), PROTANOPIA (blue / yellow) or TRITANOPIA (teal / pink) team colours. Changes the scoreboard, kill feed, radar, UAV marks, objectives, stash bags and grow spots.
FIELD OF VIEW: new ADS FIELD OF VIEW option (Settings > VIDEO). AFFECTED zooms in from your FOV; INDEPENDENT makes every sight zoom the same at any FOV. FOV checked from 60 to 110.

BETTER VOICES: the survivors now get the best voices your computer has (natural / premium voices first, never the joke ones like Bubbles or Zarvox on a Mac), with gentler pitch so they sound less robotic. New VOICE LINES SPEED slider (Settings > AUDIO) - you hear a sample when you change it.
